messages.subject: Re: newbie Q: how to load data drom a MySQL database
messages.subject_clean: newbie Q: how to load data drom a MySQL database
messages.body_plain:
belated thanks for the reply!

On Thursday, January 23, 2014 8:37:49 AM UTC-10, Ian wrote:
> Hi Rich,
>
> well, Deducer is not a web interface, so it might not be the best tool in general for your purpose. There is currently no database connection GUI for Deducer, so the only way to connect is though the command line.
>
>
> Best,
> Ian
>
>
> On Sat, Jan 18, 2014 at 9:51 AM, Rich Rath <rich...@gmail.com> wrote:
> > Hi, I am new both to R and deducer.  I I can figure our how to make a command line connection to to a mysql database and send a query.  Is there a way to bring the results of the query into Deducer, or use deducer to make the query on the fly through the database connection?  Or do I need to save to cvs and then load it as a static snapshot?  The latter won't work for my purposes.
> >
> > Purposes: make a somewhat user-friendly web interface where users can query a database and manipulate the results with R through a user interface.  May be that deducer is not the right tool for this, but I am trying it out.
> >
> > Thanks for your help.
> >
> > --

Looks like this stems from a (possible) error in the ggplot2 documentation, which does not mention "y" as an aes that geom_bar understands, when in fact it is a required aes. I'll look into fixing this.

bet,
Ian

messages.subject: Re: R crashes without a trace
messages.body_plain:
Are you talking about using the Deducer GUI within RStudio, or using Deducer within JGR launched using the JGR() function from RStudio? Launching should work fine, but using the Deducer GUI within RStudio is not supported on the mac.

messages.subject: Re: Shortcut for JGR?
messages.body_plain:
I'm able to run JGR fine, I just don't have a shortcut to run it directly from outside of R.  I installed via CRAN, and I Just don't have the launcher itself - not a major issue.

When I try to use JGR.exe to launch, it tells me I'm lacking jri.dll, though that dll is installed with rJava and again JGR runs fine when run out of R.

I think this is probably the wrong group for this, though. I  should go try to find a JGR one, though any other suggestions are welcome!

Thank you for the help so far :)

messages.subject: Re: Shortcut for JGR?
messages.body_plain:
Launching JGR outside from R involves a mix of java's, a general java engine on the pc, java launcher file for jgr and rjava. You need to have all the components installed and the versions need to be compatible.
So, launching JGR outside R has different requirements, compared to within R. Your java problem appears to be outside R, missing something.
This can be a bit tricky, because the different versions not always integrate well in my experience.
The combination of R 3.0.2 for Mac, rjava 0.9.5, JGR 1.7-16, deducer 0.7-6.1 works just fine for me.
For instance, the latest rjava update 0.9.6 didn't work for me in this setting when I tried it, so I went back to the previous version.
But as I said I am on a Mac. Never tried it on a PC. May be  someone can comment on the specific requirements and settings on a PC.
Best wishes.
